# Sharia & CMA Disclosure

Figma: [08i. Sharia & CMA Disclosure](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-961) · Family: 08 Safqah-Specific · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

Trust & compliance surface - signals that a deal is Sharia-compliant (approved by the Sharia committee) and CMA-authorized. Two forms: a green approval banner and compact compliance badges, each with a “Learn more” into the full disclosure. RTL primary.

### ComplianceBadge

Official seal with label and learn-more arrow: Shariah «متوافق مع الشريعة الإسلامية» or CMA «مصرحة من هيئة السوق المالية».

Level: atom · Part of: ShariaDisclosure

Use when:
- Calculator or pre-checkout summaries needing a compact compliance mark
- Type=CMA to show the Capital Market Authority licence
- Type=Shariah to show Sharia committee approval

Don't use when:
- On deal pages prefer ShariaDisclosure banner
- Never as decoration or for a product not actually approved

Accessibility: Seal image needs alt text naming the authority; link names the target document.

Compliance: Legal claim: exact wording from Legal/Sharia, and «إعرف أكثر» must open the real licence or fatwa.

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

Islamic-finance products must visibly state their Sharia compliance and regulatory authorization. This surface carries both: the Sharia committee’s approval and the Capital Market Authority (CMA) license, with a path to the full disclosure.

It ships in two forms - a prominent green banner for deal pages, and compact seal badges for tighter contexts (calculator, summaries).

### Anatomy

ComplianceBadge = an official seal (100px stamp) + a compliance label + a “Learn more” link. ShariaDisclosure = a brand-green banner with the approval statement, a seal, and a “Learn more” chevron.

### Parts

- Seal - the official CMA or Sharia stamp (vector art).
- Label - the compliance statement (e.g. “متوافق مع الشريعة الإسلامية”).
- Learn more (إعرف أكثر) - opens the full disclosure / fatwa reference.
- Banner statement - “جميع الصفقات المطروحة معتمدة من اللجنة الشرعية”.

### Types - ComplianceBadge

One badge, two authorities:

### Shariah

Sharia committee compliance - “متوافق مع الشريعة الإسلامية”.

### CMA

Capital Market Authority license - “مصرحة من هيئة السوق المالية”.

### ShariaDisclosure banner

The prominent form for deal pages: a brand-green banner stating all offered deals are approved by the Sharia committee, with a seal and “Learn more”.

### Direction

RTL (Arabic) is primary; LTR mirrors the layout and translates the labels - “Sharia-compliant”, “CMA-authorized”, “All offered deals are approved by the Sharia committee”. Both directions ship on ComplianceBadge (Type × Direction) and ShariaDisclosure.

### Code examples

```typescript
<ShariaDisclosure dir="rtl" onLearnMore={openFatwa} />

<ComplianceBadge type="shariah" dir="rtl" onLearnMore={openFatwa} />
<ComplianceBadge type="cma"     dir="rtl" onLearnMore={openLicence} />
```

### Usage - Do and Don't

Do

Surface the disclosure where investment decisions happen - deal pages, the calculator, the summary before checkout.

Do

Wire every “Learn more” to the real Sharia board approval / CMA licence document.

Don’t

Don’t show a compliance seal without a genuine disclosure behind it - it must be verifiable.

Don’t

Don’t shrink the seals until the stamp text is unreadable; keep them legible.

### Notes from the maintainer

> **Warning:** Compliance copy and seals are legal claims - never mock, translate loosely, or reuse them for a product that isn’t actually approved. Source the exact wording from Legal/Sharia.

> **Tip:** ComplianceBadge is the atom (Type = CMA / Shariah); the banner is the prominent form. Compose, don’t fork.

> **Info:** Labels are IBM Plex Sans Arabic (not loadable in this plugin env) so these can’t be re-instanced here - previews are exported PNGs and edits happen on the components in place.
